<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="22" x2="318" y2="27" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="19" x2="323" y2="27" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="16" x2="328" y2="27" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="25" x2="348" y2="28" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="357" y="17" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="19" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="378" y="20" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Hero news image -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="514" fill="#000000" opacity=".25"/>
    <rect x="0" y="42" width="390" height="514" rx="0" fill="#50545B"/>
    <rect x="0" y="42" width="390" height="514" fill="#263847"/>
    <circle cx="315" cy="143" r="57" fill="#F4B740" opacity=".9"/>
    <polygon points="0,414 104,274 171,346 232,240 390,414 390,556 0,556" fill="#355A68"/>
    <polygon points="0,468 75,368 135,422 215,331 390,475 390,556 0,556" fill="#1C4A58"/>
    <rect x="0" y="382" width="390" height="174" fill="#071E2B" opacity=".72"/>
    <rect x="24" y="76" width="91" height="28" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="39" y="95" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#FFFFFF">FEATURED</text>
    <text x="24" y="430" font-family="Poppins" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">The future of cities</text>
    <text x="24" y="462" font-family="Poppins" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">is being built today</text>
    <text x="24" y="500" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore the stories shaping tomorrow</text>
    <circle cx="351" cy="504" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".16"/>
    <polyline points="347,498 353,504 347,510" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Copy and progress panel -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="556" width="390" height="204" fill="#1C1E21"/>
    <text x="24" y="594" font-family="Poppins" font-size="24px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Stay informed, effortlessly</text>
    <text x="24" y="622" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Get a clearer view of the world with news</text>
    <text x="24" y="643" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">that matters to you.</text>
    
    <circle cx="173" cy="681" r="7" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="681" r="7" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <circle cx="217" cy="681" r="7" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    
    <g>
      <rect x="24" y="709" width="76" height="44" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
      <text x="62" y="737" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Back</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="290" y="709" width="76" height="44" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="328" y="737" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Next</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="84" fill="#242629"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Explore -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="48" cy="786" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="48,780 51,786 48,792 45,786" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="48" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <g>
      <rect x="130" y="777" width="14" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="133,792 137,789 141,792 141,796 133,796" fill="#242629"/>
      <text x="137" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Notifications -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="239" cy="780" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="231" y="783" width="16" height="11" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="248" cy="778" r="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="239" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Alerts</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="334" cy="780" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="334" cy="793" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="334" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
